meta.name: Typhoon Family
meta.description:
Depicts the struggles of small and medium-sized businesses and their families who face the 1997 IMF crisis head-on.

Ended · First aired 11 Oct 2025 · South Korea · Language: Korean
Studio: Studio Dragon, Studio Tri, IMAGINUS · Network: tvN

Complete series. On your server: S1 16/16

On your server — Audio: Korean

videos.title: The Season of Typhoon
videos.overview: Despite his father's disappointment, Kang Tae Pung lives a double life of reckless nights and quiet gardening. But one day, he receives unexpected news.

videos.title: Asphalt Man
videos.overview: Amid a great loss and the IMF crisis, Tae Pung struggles to tend to his father's company. But he soon recruits O Mi Seon to help him learn the ropes.

videos.title: Moonlight in Seoul
videos.overview: After barely escaping a crisis, Tae Pung and Mi Seon struggle to find a place to store the fabrics — but the solution only brings new problems.

videos.title: The Wind Cannot Stop Me
videos.overview: Tae-poong steps up as a leader, building a new partnership with Mi-seon. He heads to Busan for opportunities, unaware that fresh hardship awaits at home.

videos.title: Heaven, Where We Are
videos.overview: With Mi-seon's help, Tae-poong and his mother escape their predicament. Soon, an unexpected incident erupts in Busan, leaving Tae-poong in a panic.

videos.title: The Legend of Ambition
videos.overview: After Tae-poong makes a bold move in Busan, Mi-seon lashes out at him. But they work together to move forward — diving into the shoe export business.

videos.title: The Meaning of Life
videos.overview: Tae-poong and Mi-seon clear a hurdle in exporting safety shoes — only to face another. Later, a meeting with a friend sparks Tae-poong's next big idea.

videos.title: The Bright Days of Youth
videos.overview: After facing discrimination at work, Mi-seon doubles down on her dream. Tae-poong and his team head to Thailand to explore the market and prospects.

videos.title: Walking to the Sky
videos.overview: When Go Ma-jin finds himself troubled in Thailand, Tae-poong and Mi-seon race to find a solution — while also trying to salvage their business.

videos.title: You and I
videos.overview: Back in Seoul, the employees of Typhoon Trading Co. face a bittersweet fall from grace. Meanwhile, Tae-poong and Mi-seon navigate their growing bond.

videos.title: Tomorrow Comes Love
videos.overview: Tae-poong attempts to find a way to secure solid business with the Public Procurement Service. Meanwhile, Mi-seon sets boundaries with her feelings.

videos.title: My Reason for Living
videos.overview: As the bidding war proves to be an uphill battle, Tae-poong and his team work together to secure the deal. But things turn ugly as tension rises.

videos.title: Love Beyond Fear
videos.overview: After narrowly escaping death, Mi-seon's heart transforms. As Typhoon Trading Co. struggle to fulfil its deliveries, Tae-poong falls into despair.

videos.title: Born in the Wind
videos.overview: After Tae-poong makes a deal with Pyo Bak-ho, Pyo Hyun-jun becomes furious. Meanwhile, Tae-poong and Mi-seon embark on a short getaway with loved ones.

videos.title: The Last Match
videos.overview: Tae-poong and his employees rush to help Bae Song-jung's father in a moment of crisis. Later, they encounter the worst situation they've faced yet.

videos.title: We Met the Bluebird, and Life Goes On
videos.overview: Tae-poong and his colleagues make one last effort to end their feud with the Pyo family. Will they succeed and reclaim their business?
